models.mechanism: Recurring time acts like a press: duration applies constraint until latent content becomes an observable yield.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the duration within which the mechanism operates
supplies the result exposed by temporal pressure

structural_cues: The oath consists of a single definite noun, concentrating attention on the semantic range of one root.
The same root inventory contains duration, pressing, and extracted yield, allowing a process sequence: time -> pressure -> yield.

abductive_moves.assumption: What duration contains is tested by constraint and thereby made manifest.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The text gives only the oath and the shared root branches; it does not state that time causes extraction.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: recurring duration -> accumulated pressure -> revealed yield
alternatives: time is merely the object sworn by
pressing and yield are inactive lexical possibilities

changed_reading.before: An oath by time as neutral duration.
changed_reading.after: An oath by time as an active press that forces hidden contents to disclose their yield.

models.ablation: Removing B002 collapses the causal pressure mechanism; removing B007 leaves pressure without a specified yield, and removing 103:1 removes the model entirely.

models.mechanism: Recurring time is a medium of maturation in which vulnerable life reaches a new state and becomes enclosed or protected.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies repeated duration as the medium of development

activation_trace.literal_contribution: a girl reaching youth or menstruation
activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies a living transition into maturity
supplies enclosure as the material form of attained development

structural_cues: A definite temporal noun is presented without an explicit event, leaving the kind of change wrought through time open.
Within the one root, recurring time stands beside two state-change images: reaching youth and grain entering its sheath.

abductive_moves.assumption: The two developmental branches are parallel outcomes produced through temporal recurrence, with enclosure functioning as protection rather than confinement.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Neither causation by time nor the protective value of the husk is stated in the focus phrase.
alternatives: the puberty and grain branches are unrelated homonymous extensions
enclosure signifies restriction rather than protection

changed_reading.after: An oath by time as the medium that ripens beings into changed and provisionally protected forms.

models.ablation: Removing either B009 or B010 destroys the cross-domain maturation analogy; removing B001 makes it a static pair of images rather than a temporal mechanism.

surprise_reading: At baseline, the oath can tentatively present time not as empty duration but as an active medium: it either presses hidden contents into yield or ripens vulnerable life into a newly enclosed form.
